summary:
Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Nothing was committed. I did not run tests, mypy, or black; everything was checked by reading only.

Judgment calls to review:
- Mode 'tr' normalizes to 'rt' and passes validation, but returns a binary reader, following the spec's exact-string rule.
- I added a third str-mode overload returning Union[TextIO, BinaryIO] on both open entry points, so the internal call type-checks.
- I added delegating mode and name properties on the reader, so it can be instantiated on Python 3.6.
- The file-reader display uses a text column (only when the description is non-empty), the bar, DownloadColumn, and TimeRemainingColumn, with no percentage column.
- The module-level open shadows the builtin inside rich/progress.py; the reader uses io.open internally.

Open risks: the new tests have not been run. mypy strict may flag an unused suppression depending on how it resolves the readinto, readline, or return lines. Black may reflow some hand-wrapped test calls.
